definitions.short: a Nechelamite , or descendant of Nechlam
definitions.full: H5161. Nechelami נֶחֱלָמִי adjective, of a people (noun not found); — Jer 29:24 ; also 29:31 ; 29:32 (Where van d. H. נֶחְלָמִי ). נַחֲלָת see נַחֲלֶה .
